title: Burgers
body: Our first Burgerverse collection will consist of 7,777 unique NFT Burgers. Join our Discord community to make sure to get your own Burger. Mix it later with your favorite intergalactic Side Dishes and more.

title: Side dishes
body: For our second collection, we will release NFT Side Dishes. Sounds crazy? There’s more!As a reward for their trust and loyalty, we will give all of our first drop Burger NFT holders one Side Dish NFT for free.
